description: Evidence contract for canonical fictional OTA technical objects consumed by NOXIA or other applications.

rules.H: Test evidence, constraints, alternatives and uncertainty; never auto-promote to R.
rules.T: Research real premises and engineering constraints; do not treat model choice as established.
rules.F: Do not externally validate fictional canon or gameplay placeholder values.
rules.W: Do not externally validate authorial/work stipulations.
rules.balancing: NOXIA gameplay values are derived consumer data and must never be automatically overwritten by evidence corrections.
